entities.name: EU–US Data Privacy Framework

entities.summary: The EU–US Data Privacy Framework is a European Union–United States data transfer framework established under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), agreed to in 2022, declared adequate by the European Commission in 2023, and extended to the European Economic Area (EEA) in 2024.
